description.fallback: A small man appears (Nukesaku, Japanese for idiot; 抜け作), his ear to the ground of DIO's mansion, noting Vanilla Ice, Kenny G. and Telence T. D'Arby's demise. With a stroke, he launches himself to the ceiling of the room, hissing, and reflecting on the typical dismissal the three afforded him; casually calling him by "Idiot." Stating his aim to claim Jotaro's death for himself, he somersaults down a staircase…
